simple.meaning: קוֹעַ (Qôwaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Koa , a region of Babylon.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

definitions.full: H6970. Qoa קוֺעַ proper name, of a people named with Babylonian, Chaldean, Assyrian, וְק וְ)שׁוֺעַ ׳(מְּקוֺד Ezek 23:23 Šô±a and †ô±a ; identification by Dl Pa 235 with Assyrian Sutû, Kutû (abbreviated Su (? see שׁוֺעַ ) and [by inference] Ku ), east of Tigris, on border of Elam and Media; compare COT 23:23 Dr Hast. iii, KOA ; but קוֺעַ = Kutû now doubted by Wkl Altor, Forsch. ii. 2 (1899), 54 .
